'''Fal Sion''' is a city-fortress in [[Shienar]].

Fal Sion sends forces with other Shienarans to fight the [[Trolloc]] army at [[Tarwin's Gap]].{{ref/book|1|48}}

== Etymology ==

Fal Sion may derive its name from the Biblical Zion, which is sometimes spelled 'Sion'.
